content.title: Medical | The Elmet Group
content.text: Driving innovation and Enhancing Precision ForMedical Applications When device failure is not an option, our components deliver the reliability and precision that critical medical applications require. Our products support medical detection and treatment, imaging and oncology, isotope production, shielding, medical foam and polymer production, and x-ray filtering. Used By Them. Relied upon across the medical device supply chain, providing the precision components and continuity that patient-critical manufacturing demands. Made By Us. A qualified and trusted line of highly-engineered components and specialized materials for advanced medical platforms requiring ultra-precision. 95+ National Laboratory Programs Long-standing support of medical discovery and complex scientific programs at national laboratories and high-powered energy research facilities. Talent is our strongest material. Our engineers, researchers, metallurgists, and technicians bring the expertise medical standards require. 95+ Year Legacy of Innovation Our legacy of innovation began nearly a century ago, when the first Elmet site was established in 1929 as The American Electro Metal Corporation. Cleanroom To Clinical Manufactured for ultra-precise patient outcomes, our components are embedded in diagnostic imaging systems, robotic-assisted surgical devices, radiation oncology platforms, and isotope production equipment. Trusted By Them. When device performance is measured in microns and outcomes are measured in lives, medical technology OEMs trust us to deliver without compromise. Tested By Us. With quality and validation embedded into every step of our process, we deliver the material and component consistency that ultra-precise applications require. Precision Meets Performance. Critical Materials. Critical Processes. Critical Engineering. Critical Manufacturing. When medical technology demands accuracy, our components rise to the occasion.
